Three markets, three rulebooks

Three markets, three different compliance setups. I made sure opt-ins, unsubscribe flows and audience segmentation followed the requirements of each market, covering everything from CAN-SPAM and CCPA to UK GDPR and GDPR.

One strategy, adapted by market

The UK holiday calendar doesn’t match the US and Canadian one, so those sends move a day or lose the holiday mention.

Never two in a day

The automated emails pause whenever a campaign goes out.

Scope

What I handle

With 4 years in content marketing management and almost 3 years hands-on in Klaviyo, I build email setups that feel natural to read and actually make sales for DTC ecommerce wellness and lifestyle brands.

🗓️ Planning

Email marketing calendar

Planning yearly and seasonal campaigns around launches, promotions, holidays, and everything in between (while keeping the calendar realistic and organized).

✍️ Making

Concept, copy, design direction

Coming up with the idea, writing the copy, and giving designers a clear direction for the campaign.

🎯 Targeting

Segments & audiences

Building Klaviyo segments around customer behavior, engagement, purchases, location, and lifecycle, so the right people get the right emails.

🔄 Automation

Flows & sequences

Building and managing Klaviyo flows, from welcome and abandoned cart to post-purchase and re-engagement, making sure each lead keeps moving.

📝 Growth

Signup forms & testing

Creating and testing Klaviyo signup forms, offers, and messaging to turn more visitors into subscribers without making the website feel like a pop-up battlefield.

🧪 Shipping

QA, A/B testing & sending

Testing subject lines, content, CTAs, and timing, then checking links, layouts, and everything else before hitting send.

Fair warning

The Reality of Hiring Me

Expectations

Clean flows that recover abandoned carts, welcome new customers and keep VIPs engaged.
Reliable delivery, realistic timelines and clear performance reporting.
A calm, measured approach to seasonal planning.
Professional, thoughtful communication.

Reality

A deep personal grudge against the new Klaviyo editor. It will come up. Probably in the interview.
Will send you a competitor’s email at 1 AM with absolutely no context except: “look at this 💀”
Screenshot folder is 400 emails deep. No system. Purely vibes.
Cannot hit send until every link has been clicked three times.
